scope: Actual view_image inspection of the six non-policy captures from the completed fresh-France browser journey. Policy desktop/narrow captures were assigned separately to the root reviewer. No browser rerun or source edits.
nonblocking_findings: The previous stale-review toast remains visible in the fresh-review capture; primary review controls are unobscured.
At 390px the horizontal government tab strip displays a partial Parliament & parties label and later tabs lie offscreen. This visual review does not establish their interaction behavior.

observations: Review title, political and financial cost labels, full before/after effects table and both decision buttons are readable at desktop size.
A map-help banner is visible above the review without obscuring its title, effects or actions.
Decisions & commitments title and interior art are visible. The modal is scrolled to campaign aims.
The footer clearly states: Decision recorded on 1 Jan 1990. The figures now show the result. The standing-policy form is outside this capture.
The old review is absent. A readable persistent notice explicitly says the review is out of date and nothing was applied.
Current decision cards, their costs and Review decision buttons are readable. A duplicate toast partially overlaps the upper navigation, not the notice or decision cards.
Fresh review title, 17.14 PC and $0 costs, before/after table, Confirm decision and Keep considering are visible without clipping.
The preceding stale-review toast is still visible above this fresh review in the capture. It does not obscure review controls, but can momentarily suggest that the new review is stale.
Readable completed-action feedback appears above the available decisions.
Expel French Communist Party now appears as an available action. Decision names, costs and review buttons are visible. Lower reform content continues below this viewport.
At 390 by 844 pixels, France and 1 Jan 1990 are readable over the government art. The selected Governing decisions tab, filters, search label/input and first card title/cost are readable.

The tab strip shows part of Parliament & parties and later tabs are offscreen. Horizontal interaction was not re-tested during this screenshot-only review. The first card continues below the viewport.

limitations: Screenshot observations do not independently prove command effects, save equality or keyboard/accessibility behavior; those have separate native/browser evidence.
Only the visible regions were inspected; content below the viewport is not asserted absent or clipped.
No universal country or device visual qualification is claimed.
